# University of Colorado Boulder

> > CU Boulder is a leading public research university offering undergraduate and graduate programs across arts, sciences, engineering, business, and music, with significant research funding from NASA, NSF, and NIH.

Located in Boulder, Colorado at the base of the Rocky Mountains, CU Boulder is recognized by U.S. News & World Report and Princeton Review for academic excellence. The university features specialized research institutes including the BioFrontiers Institute and offers innovative programs in quantum engineering, integrative physiology, finance, and communication.

## Admissions & Campus Visits

- [4 Easy Steps to Confirm](http://www.colorado.edu/bb/confirm): Enrollment confirmation steps for admitted students to become Buffs
- [Admissions Visits](http://www.colorado.edu/admissions/visit): Admissions visit experiences for prospective first-year & transfer students
- [First-Year - Plan](http://www.colorado.edu/admissions/process/first-year/plan): First-year admission planning with holistic review & academic requirements
- [Visit Campus](http://www.colorado.edu/visit-campus): Campus visit info with tours, museums, planetarium & parking details

## Undergraduate Programs

- [Bachelor of Arts in Communication](http://www.colorado.edu/academics/ba-communication): BA in Communication from CMCI with analytical & transformative focus
- [Bachelor of Arts in Integrative Physiology](http://www.colorado.edu/academics/ba-integrative-physiology): BA in integrative physiology covering anatomy, biochemistry & health sciences
- [Bachelor of Arts in Italian](http://www.colorado.edu/academics/ba-italian): BA in Italian language, literature & culture with study abroad options
- [Minor in Music](http://www.colorado.edu/academics/minor-music): Music minor with theory, ensemble & electives from College of Music
- [Minor in Quantum Engineering](http://www.colorado.edu/academics/minor-quantum-engineering): Undergraduate minor in quantum engineering through College of Engineering

## Graduate Programs

- [Graduate Degrees in Finance](http://www.colorado.edu/academics/grad-finance): MS Finance program at Leeds School with corporate & investment tracks

## Certificate Programs

- [Certificates](http://www.colorado.edu/academics/programs/certificates): Overview of undergraduate certificate programs for skill enhancement
- [Certificate in Central & Eastern European Studies](http://www.colorado.edu/academics/certificate-central-eastern-european-studies): Interdisciplinary certificate covering Russia, Hungary & Eastern Europe
- [Certificate in Social Innovation](http://www.colorado.edu/academics/certificate-social-innovation): Sociology certificate for social innovation & vulnerable population work
- [Certificate in Social Responsibility & Ethics](http://www.colorado.edu/academics/certificate-social-responsibility-ethics): Leeds business ethics certificate for values-driven leadership development

## Research & Innovation

- [Biosciences in Research Institutes](http://www.colorado.edu/research/focus/biosciences/research-institutes): BioFrontiers & behavioral genetics research institutes overview
- [Faculty Leaders](http://www.colorado.edu/research/focus/biosciences/faculty-leaders): Bioscience faculty leaders including Caruthers & Cech in research ecosystem
- [Research Funding Highlights FY23-24](http://www.colorado.edu/research/report/research-creative-work-2023-24/research-funding-highlights-fy23-24): FY23-24 research funding highlights with NASA & NSF investments
- [Research Funding Highlights FY17-18](http://www.colorado.edu/research/report/2017-18/research-funding-highlights): FY17-18 annual report showing $511M in external research funding
- [Letter from the Vice Chancellor for Research & Innovation 2018-19](http://www.colorado.edu/research/report/2018-19/letter-vice-chancellor): Vice Chancellor Terri Fiez's 2018-19 research highlights letter
